reasoning_content:
The init view is just `<div id="app">` and the legacy `application.js`. So does the root page boot the app via the legacy Sprockets asset pipeline (jQuery + compiled JS in `application.js`), or is the Zammad 7.x frontend served through the Vite pipeline and injected? Wait — the root page was only loading `/assets/application.js` and form.js, with no Vite script tags. But Zammad 7 has a Vue3 frontend… let me check `application.html.erb` to see what's included there, and also check how `application.js` boots the app. Maybe the SPA is now compiled via Vite and served as `/assets/application.js` through the Sprockets pipeline that Vite feeds into? No, that's not it…

Actually, in Zammad 6.x/7.x, the new frontend (Vue) is in `app/frontend`, and it's served by Vite in development. The init page should include a `vite_typescript_tag`. But the rendered root page only showed the script tag for `/assets/application.js`. Hmm, but that root page is rendered by `init#index` using the `application.html.erb` layout. Let me look at application.html.erb and check whether there's a vite tag.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
cd /workspaces/workspace
cat app/views/layouts/application.html.erb
' 2>&1
